verdict.rationale: Internal comment side-threads on an email are a fair axis for an email client, but the evidence pack never documents commenting or @mentioning beside a message. The closest items are adjacent features: standalone notes, flags, and categories. None of them provides a shared, internal discussion thread attached to a message.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
